title: Quick Tip: Business Central Updates 27.1 & 27.2: A Quick Look at What’s New
summary: Updates 27.1 and 27.2 introduce intelligent agents for automation, improved e-document processing with Peppol support, regional tax enhancements for Czechia and the US, SEPA compliance features, and admin improvements including the ability to cancel running environment updates.
key_points: Payables Agent and Sales Order Agent are now generally available, with preview support for MCP agent integration
E-document workflows enhanced with two-step processing and Power Automate integration, plus extended support for shipment and transfer documents
New Account Payable Role Center and concealed text field type added for reporting and data security
Regional improvements include VAT drill-downs for Czechia, 1099 enhancements for the US, and SEPA CAMT0530008 support
Admin enhancement allows cancellation of running environment updates in 27.2
features: Power Automate support for document workflows

quotes.text: Payables Agent and Sales Order Agent
quotes.why_it_matters: General availability of these agents marks the expansion of intelligent automation capabilities in core business functions

quotes.text: Support for shipment and transfer documents as e-documents
quotes.why_it_matters: Extends e-document processing beyond invoices to more document types, improving digital workflow completeness

quotes.text: Ability to cancel a running environment update
quotes.why_it_matters: Provides administrators more control and flexibility over the update process to minimize disruption
